description: Extract contact and business details from a company website: name, phone numbers (normalised), emails, WhatsApp, postal address, opening hours, social profiles, review platforms, booking and chat tools, UK company and VAT numbers, and page headings. Reads the homepage plus its contact page when the homepage lacks a phone or email. Every value comes from the site itself. Costs 0.02 USDC per completed call, paid automatically via x402 if your client supports it. Never charged if the call fails.
